name: dockerfile_lint
description: Lint a Dockerfile given inline with rules modelled on hadolint, citing its rule ids: untagged or :latest base images (DL3006, DL3007), last USER root (DL3002), sudo (DL3004), apt-get without -y, --no-install-recommends, pinned versions or removal of the apt lists (DL3014, DL3015, DL3008, DL3009), apt instead of apt-get (DL3027), ADD for local files (DL3020), relative WORKDIR (DL3000), shell-form CMD/ENTRYPOINT (DL3025), MAINTAINER (DL4000), multiple CMD or ENTRYPOINT (DL4003, DL4004); plus its own: no USER at all, secret-looking ENV/ARG names, downloads piped into a shell.

ignore.description: Rule ids to skip; # hadolint ignore=ID comments are honoured too

findings.message: Always tag the version of an image explicitly.
Last USER should not be root.

catalog.source: hadolint rule set (github.com/hadolint/hadolint README and wiki pages DL3000-DL4004: ids, severities, messages and examples); Docker build check SecretsUsedInArgOrEnv for the secrets rule
